visualCharacteristics: Dark ink (#151f27) call-to-action band with a centred white 28/36/42 px statement and a white pill button with an arrow glyph below.
contentPattern: Rows classified by content: paragraph(s)/heading without a link = statement; the paragraph holding a link = CTA button.
usage: Use as a centred call-to-action band that points visitors to the newsroom or another key page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any single-statement CTA band by authoring one text row and one link row.
